baselineName: CI-P3B: exact sealed canonical portable promoted into Field Capture
policy: CI-P3 build-once/package-many now uses one sealed Windows package as the exact-byte promotion substrate for installer validation and PR Field Capture. P3B removes the normal PR Field Capture native/.NET republish after P3A proved matching independent builders are byte-reproducible; field-specific source/wire checks and runtime smoke remain independent, while workflow_dispatch retains an independent publish fallback.
interpretation: The limits freeze CI sprawl; they are not performance targets and do not prove semantic necessity.
CI-P1 is expected to reduce restore/build/test counts and introduce reusable workflow_call contracts. Any temporary migration increase must be explicit in the same reviewed change.
Release, physical evidence and IEC 61850 acceptance semantics remain owned by their existing contracts during CI-P0.

ciP1MigrationShadow.purpose: Two additive workflows: one advisory change classifier and one reusable exact-SHA Windows compile/test job for opt-in shadow parity. No legacy workflow retired or replaced.
ciP1MigrationShadow.exitGate: Only retire a legacy workflow or lower limits after shadow parity on matching source/engine SHAs, equivalent test verdicts, and explicit review of physical/release gate ownership. No release/promotion claim based on shadow results.

ciP2Consolidation.approach: Reuse completed canonical Build ARSAS exact-merge-SHA full-regression TRX artifact; no duplicate .NET compile for PR events. Keep original source-contract check and status name, read-only API, manual fallback via reusable full build/test.

candidateVerification.canonicalRun: successful latest matching PR head/branch run
candidateVerification.tests: Workflow-produced, not cryptographically signed, exact-SHA manifest plus independently verified all-pass TRX SHA-256 and counters.

ciP2Consolidation.rollback: Restore original smart-discovery-merge-execution-guard.yml build/test steps if canonical evidence or cross-run matching causes flakiness; never skip P0-5h source-contract checks.

ciP2MainlineReadiness.approach: After preserving R10 physical authority and running the engine's independent full restore/build/test, reuse immutable successful canonical Build ARSAS exact PR merge/engine SHA artifact instead of a second application restore/build/test. No cross-run proof bypass.
ciP2MainlineReadiness.rollback: Restore direct application restore/build/test step if verifier fails legitimate parity; retain current R10 evidence and engine full tests without modification.

ciP2ProductionRoute.approach: For PRs independently verify source route and its unchanged SHA256 before/after consuming exact-PR-merge + exact-engine-commit full-regression canonical Build ARSAS proof. Preserve manual full regression via reusable Windows workflow.
ciP2ProductionRoute.evidence: Latest successful canonical Build ARSAS matching exact PR head/branch, merge SHA, immutable engine SHA, passing all-test TRX digest/counters
ciP2ProductionRoute.rollback: Revert this workflow change to restore direct production-route .NET build/test if canonical proof or sequencing fails. Never omit source route checks.

observedReferenceRun.note: Observed timing is diagnostic evidence only, not a hard CI timing assertion.

ciP2ArtifactReady.rollback: Remove the opt-in flag from P2A/P2B/P2C consumers to restore completed-workflow waiting without changing evidence formats or physical/release authority.

ciP2PostMergeMainReuse.approach: On push/main, preserve R10 physical assertions and independent engine restore/build/test, then consume exact same-main-SHA canonical Build ARSAS push artifact using event=push, branch=main, exact engine SHA and artifact-ready proof.
ciP2PostMergeMainReuse.rollback: Restore direct ARSAS main restore/build/test in post-merge workflow; keep independent engine test and physical convergence assertions unchanged.

ciP2FieldCaptureRegressionReuse.approach: Preserve exact Field Capture source checks, P0-5d fixtures, integration engine checkout, independent publish and smoke; replace duplicate application restore/build/full-test with exact canonical Build ARSAS regression evidence. Manual dispatch retains full regression through reusable CI-P1 before packaging.
ciP2FieldCaptureRegressionReuse.rollback: Restore direct Field Capture restore/build/dotnet test steps; do not substitute canonical EXE unless future reproducible-build evidence proves byte identity.

ciP3CanonicalWindowsPackage.approach: Build ARSAS builds/tests once, builds one pinned ArdIrec bridge, uses those exact bridge bytes for installer-input and portable outputs, runs managed native integration tests, portable smoke, seals all package/test bytes into a hash-complete artifact, and installer PR/main consumes the exact package rather than restoring/building/publishing ARSAS again.
ciP3CanonicalWindowsPackage.staticBudgetNote: Manual installer workflow_dispatch fallback intentionally keeps restore/build/full-test source commands in YAML, so static restore/build counts do not fall even though PR/main execution removes them.
proof: every installer-input and verification payload file SHA-256
ciP3CanonicalWindowsPackage.rollback: Restore installer PR/main source restore/build/test/publish/stage steps and stop consuming ARSAS-windows-package-input. Keep sealed artifact producer/verifier available for diagnosis; never weaken hash or identity checks.

ciP3ReproduciblePortableBuild.approach: Request reproducible MSVC bridge linking, explicit deterministic .NET publish, and emit source/engine/ArdIrec/bridge/portable hash identity from both existing independent builders. No binary promotion until cross-run parity is proven.
ciP3ReproduciblePortableBuild.acceptance: Matching source, ARIEC61850 and ArdIrec inputs must yield identical bridge and portable SHA-256 across independent workflow runs.
ciP3ReproduciblePortableBuild.rollback: Remove P3A deterministic flags and identity artifact additions only if toolchain incompatibility is proven; retain P2F binary-reuse prohibition.

ciP3CanonicalPortablePromotion.approach: On pull_request consume the exact hash-complete ARSAS-windows-package-input already produced by Build ARSAS. The shared sealed-package verifier validates exact PR head/branch, synthetic merge/source SHA, ARIEC61850 SHA, ArdIrec SHA, workflow run/attempt, all-pass TRX counters, portable/native hashes and the sealed portable build-identity before materialization. Field Capture retains P0-5c/P0-5d/physical checks, then smoke-tests and republishes those exact canonical portable bytes under the stable field artifact contract. workflow_dispatch retains independent publish.
ciP3CanonicalPortablePromotion.rollback: Restore PR Field Capture independent publish path if sealed package promotion becomes unavailable; never bypass exact package identity, digest, build-identity or runtime-smoke validation.
